title: San Diego Family Trip with Major Attraction Closure

scenario.description: A family trip to San Diego centered around a full-day visit to a major animal park. A sudden weekend closure of the park forces the family to find alternative full-day entertainment without exceeding the budget.

dynamic_events.description: The major animal park you scheduled for Saturday just announced a total closure for the entire weekend due to a power facility failure. You must cancel these tickets and find alternative family-friendly attractions (like aquariums or interactive museums) to fill the Saturday schedule.
resolution_requirements: Remove the cancelled major animal park from the itinerary
Book alternative family-friendly attractions to cover the empty Saturday schedule
Ensure the replacement activities are suitable for a family with children
Verify that the overall trip remains under the $3500 budget

expected_challenges: Agent must completely replace a massive chunk of the schedule (a full-day activity) with a combination of smaller alternative activities.
Maintaining the semantic requirement of 'family-friendly' for the replacement activities.
Rebalancing the budget after refunding a likely expensive theme park ticket and buying new attraction tickets.
notes: Tests large-block schedule replacement. The agent must fill a newly created void in the itinerary with semantically appropriate alternatives.
